szenen.vo: [intense] Listen to me, bro. Nobody is coming to save you. Nobody.
[intense] No message, no perfect chance, no one knocking on your door with the life you want.
[intense] And here's the crazy part. That door was never locked. You just never pushed it.
[intense] Everyone else is busy fighting their own battles. They're not thinking about you.
[intense] There is exactly one person who can change your life.
[shouting] And you see that person every single morning in the mirror!
[intense] Scary? Good. That means it actually matters.
[intense] Nobody will build it for you, so build it yourself. Brick by brick.
[shouting] Stop waiting to be saved. Be the one who saves you!
